owner_directive: Finish ClayCode as a general-purpose executable programming language/semantic IR and compiler/runtime before Clay 0.1. Preserve existing FRANK/XENO/ClayCode semantics wherever possible: less redesign, more compilation, lowering, runtime, FFI, stdlib and real application execution. Frank v0.1 execution/release target is exclusively the Ubuntu Linux developer system; Android/mobile/edge portability is out of scope until the owner explicitly reopens it.
coordination_rule: Workers prefer compiler/runtime/toolchain implementation over semantic redesign. A ClayCode semantic change requires a concrete executable application or FRANK counterexample showing the existing semantics cannot express/lower the needed behavior. Non-Ubuntu portability work is not current v0.1 work.

blocker_burndown.accounting_rule: Do not promote any package from proxy/research evidence alone. Update package status only from its stated production/Ubuntu acceptance receipts.

CC-WP-01-SPEC-FREEZE.goal: Fuse existing candidates into one frozen executable semantic contract; preserve current semantics unless a real compiler/application counterexample forces change.

CC-WP-02-PARSER-CANON.goal: Parser plus deterministic canonicalizer for the frozen representation.

CC-WP-03-IR-TYPES.goal: Typed canonical IR, collections, epistemic state, semantic identity and universal computational core.

CC-WP-04-TYPE-EFFECT.goal: Validator/type/effect checker with precise diagnostics; preserve expressibility != authority.

CC-WP-05-EVALUATOR.goal: Reference evaluator/interpreter for executable core semantics.

CC-WP-06-COMPILER-LOWERING.goal: Real compiler/lowering pipeline with translation-validation contracts; first useful Ubuntu-native and/or WASM/WASI target used on Ubuntu.

CC-WP-07-RUNTIME-ABI-FFI.goal: Ubuntu/Linux runtime ABI, typed host FFI, capability/effect gateway, modules/packages and explicit resource identity for Frank v0.1.

CC-WP-08-STDLIB-SDK.goal: Minimal standard library/SDK for algorithms, collections, files/processes, HTTP/network, database adapters, async/concurrency, UI/event-loop adapters and backend interop on Ubuntu.

CC-WP-09-CONCURRENCY-MEMORY.goal: Define/implement errors, async/concurrency, atomics/resource/memory semantics sufficient for real Ubuntu applications and backend lowering.

CC-WP-10-GENERAL-APP-SUITE.goal: Compile and execute mandatory general-purpose application proof suite on Ubuntu: CLI, real website/HTTP service, DB-backed service, concurrent service, GUI/interactive app, compiler/tool, GPU/ML/numerical backend, sandboxed system effect and FRANK component.

CC-WP-12-CORPUS-HELDOUT.goal: Semantics-derived positive/negative training corpus generator plus leak-resistant held-out/eval suite.

CC-WP-13-HARNESS-HANDOFF.goal: Compile real frozen FRANK subsystem(s), prove no semantic escape hatch is needed and hand stable Ubuntu-targeted compiler/runtime into H2/H3.

CC-WP-14-BASE-AUDIT.goal: General-purpose manifest, hashes, Ubuntu executable application receipts, unresolved-language-counterexample audit and PASS decision.

application_acceptance.rule: Representability is insufficient; each applicable proof must compile/lower and execute with a reproducible receipt on the Ubuntu developer-system target before Frank v0.1 BASE PASS.

live_claims.claim: All fourteen coarse BASE packages have one receipt-gated executable closure path; no package is credited as PASS from research proxies alone.
WP-01 is closed by an explicit BASE semantic freeze; semantic redesign is closed by default unless an executable counterexample requires a versioned amendment.

CC-WP-02 parser/canonicalizer is closed for the selected BASE-D V18 component set by exact-byte self-hosted Ubuntu strict/full-corpus/canonical/mutation/parity evidence. This is a package PASS only; BASE release and Andreas target acceptance remain NOT_PASS.
